name: Moddable Engine API
description: Static JSON API for the Moddable board game engine

endpoints.description: Piece gallery — 117 SVG sets across chess, shogi, xiangqi, Go, draughts, backgammon
Board gallery — 333 rendered SVG diagrams spanning 33 game families
Tile gallery — 8 hex tile sets for strategy maps
Chess puzzles — 1,726 tactical puzzles with FEN, solutions, and difficulty ratings

exports.core: Event bus, RNG, state store, player system, move pipeline
exports.plugins: All 13 game families (chess, go, mancala, morris, draughts, reversi, halma, shogi, xiangqi, backgammon, big2, hex, race)
exports.component-deck: 6 deck types, shuffle, deal, tableau layout
exports.hex-generators: Map generation for 6 hex games (nukes, twilight, talisman, colony, mongo, endless)
exports.rpg: Entity search, oracle rolls, card data, link resolution, manifest loading
exports.ai: Minimax, MCTS, evaluators for 9 game families
